recentItems.title: Israel Election Result: Arab Parties Turn Kingmakers Amid Deadlock? Netanyahu Or Eisenkot For PM?
recentItems.description:
Israel’s election has triggered a political deadlock! Netanyahu’s bloc is projected to win 53 seats, while Gadi Eisenkot’s opposition bloc could secure 48. But the biggest twist? Arab-led parties could win a record 19 seats, potentially becoming kingmakers. With 61 seats needed for a majority, who will form Israel’s next government? Could Arab lawmakers decide Netanyahu’s political future, or will former rivals unite in a national unity government? The numbers are almost clear, but the political choices are far more complicated. recentItems.title: Iran Claims 3 Tankers Trying To Leave Unauthorised Hormuz Route Hit As IRGC Captures US Spy Drone?
recentItems.description:

Iranian forces have also claimed to capture a US spy drone west of the strait, raising fresh questions over maritime security and tensions between Tehran and Washington.

recentItems.title: Iran IRGC Captures US Army Spy Drone MQM-170 In West Of Hormuz As Trump Mulls Fresh Attack?
recentItems.description:
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claims it has captured a US military spy drone, identified in its statement as the MQM-170, west of the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran alleges the drone was on a mission to identify Iranian air defence systems along the Persian Gulf coastline. The claim comes amid heightened regional tensions and questions over Washington's next move.
